==Description==
'''v1.60.0''' is the one hundred and eleventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of April 2025. It brought back the [[PVP Test]] and introduced the [[Hot Spot]] map.

This version contained two updates, the main v1.60.0 (released 9 April 2025) and the minor v1.60.1 (released 9 April 2025).

==Additions==
===Maps===
*[[Warm Land]] (PVP)
*[[Judging Hall]] (PVP)
*[[Laser Stadium]] (PVP)
*[[Crash Course]] (PVP)
*[[Hot Spot]] (Survival & Hardcore)

===Consumables===
*[[Airhorn]] (PVP)
*[[Energy Drink]] (PVP)
*[[Protein Shake]] (PVP)

===Miscellaneous===
*[[PVP Test]]
*[[Settings#Keybinds|Toggle Enemy Spawner]] Keybind

*[[April Fools 2025 Event]]
*[[Baseplate-L]]
*[[Baseplate-W]]
*[[April fools 2025]]

== Changes & Bugfixes ==
*[[PVP Test]] changed.
**Updated wave structure, now is three different modes based on player ranks. This can put players in Low, Mid and High Rank wave structures.
**Added two different modes, casual and ranked.
***Casual plays like '''PVP Test''' used to.
***Ranked allows players to ban up to two towers per team.
**Game will now wait for all players to load in before a match can be started.
**Final wave is now infinite and once all enemies spawned it repeats itself.
**Golden perks and exclusive category towers can no longer be used.
**Infinite waves now end once a team kills all enemies from the wave.
**Economy bonus time decreased from 10 to 8 seconds.
**Enemy send statistics changed.
**Now allows the usage of consumables, but only '''PVP Test''' exclusive consumables. Such consumables have infinite uses, but have a usage cost.
**Slightly updated UI, including spawn menus.
**Towers on the triumph screen replaced with players from the winning team.
**Added the ability to view the map from a bird-eye view.
**Fixed players in a [[Party]] not being in the same team in 2v2 matches.
**Fixed units being able to kill the opponent's units.
**Fixed [[Boss]] health bars from a [[Boss]] enemy on one side appearing for both players.
**Fixed triumphing '''PVP Test''' counting as triumphing any mode.
**Fixed towers breaking when they have a tower from the opponent's team in their range.
**Fixed final wave not being infinite.
*Added tower roles for towers, which are used to put towers in [[PVP Test]] inventory into categories. There are three roles:

*Fixed [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] enemies listing their health and speed as 0.
*Fixed [[Elf Camp]] skins other than default not having icons.
*Fixed [[Trapper]] range getting doubled visually when upgraded on a Level that boosts its range while also having its trap set to spike.
*Fixed [[Firework Technician]] selling breaking when a tower was sold in its range.
